Implemented and reconciled the UI with `theme.js`:

- Added accessible “Dark mode” checkbox in settings.
- Applies saved preference first; otherwise uses OS dark-mode preference.
- Persists explicit selections safely in localStorage.
- Updates with OS preference changes only until a choice is saved.
- Added dark-mode CSS variables and native color-scheme support.
